prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” HVAC company for everyone — the right choice depends on your location in Houston, whether it’s a home or business, how quickly you need service, your budget, and whether you want a one-time repair or a long-term service plan. That said, some companies with large Houston presences and generally strong reputations you can consider researching are:

- John Moore Services  
- ABC Home & Commercial Services  
- ARS/Rescue Rooter (local franchises)  
- One Hour Heating & Air Conditioning / Benjamin Franklin (local franchises)  
- Local independent NATE-certified techs (often good for fair pricing and personalized service)

How to pick the best one for your situation
- Read recent local reviews (Google, Yelp, Angi, BBB) for complaints about workmanship, pricing, and timeliness.  
- Confirm the technician is NATE-certified and ask for their license/insurance information.  
- Ask about diagnostic fees, labor rates, and whether estimates are written.  
- Get a clear parts and labor warranty in writing.  
- Ask if they offer emergency/after-hours service and what the extra charge is.  
- Request references for similar jobs in your neighborhood if it’s a major repair or replacement.  
- Compare at least two written estimates before committing (unless it’s an emergency).

If you want, tell me your Houston ZIP code and whether this is a residential or commercial repair and I’ll give 3–5 well-reviewed options near you and what to expect for response time and typical diagnostic fees.
